cause_quote: The diff replaced the borders on `.btn__spinner` with `background: currentColor;` and `mask: var(--spinner-mask);` on the same element that retained `animation: btn-spinner-spin 0.7s linear infinite;`.
user_saw: The Control UI used more CPU in WebKit when spinners were visible on a page that was repainting, such as during a running chat reply.
summary: The fix moved spinner masks to static pseudo-elements so WebKit could animate the hosts without the extra per-frame GPU work.
reasoning: I checked the causing diff and its parent and confirmed that the same rotation already worked with border-drawn spinners before #189847 applied masks to the animated elements. The fix PR reports that restoring the old border art eliminated the measured GPU-process cost under the same repaint conditions, tying the added cost to the masking change.
